title: DCLab's charts drawn in the chat, and a choice asked as a card (D9)
request: Owner: build D9 (real charts from DCLab's records, review budgets, options as clickable cards); do not wait for me.
spec: dclab-code web/charts.js (new), web/app.js (showCharts), web/style.css (chart tokens), server/prompts/system_append.md, tests/page.test.js, tests/fixtures/charts_bnpl.json
plan: hook get_charts' answer like the draft card
draw dots with spread, intervals, lines, calibration, tables
look at it in light and dark
prompt: plots to get_charts, choices to AskUserQuestion

decisions.decision: scores as dots with their fold spread, not bars
decisions.why: an AUC bar starts at zero and hides gaps of 0.01-0.06

decisions.decision: one series colour plus a dashed, labelled neutral reference
decisions.why: palette check: light #2563eb/#75819a passes all but chroma (a neutral reference by design); dark #5b9bff/#8f9bb3 failed the normal-vision floor, #4f8ff7/#5d6880 passes

decisions.decision: the page draws only what get_charts returned and never computes a score
decisions.why: numbers come from DCLab's code; a cut or non-JSON output leaves the step's text and draws nothing

decisions.decision: AskUserQuestion only for a pick between options, not when numbers are needed
decisions.why: live: the review-capacity question needed the team's numbers and was answered from the budgets; the model choice came as a card

findings.defect: a reference label sat on the holdout's dot
findings.scenario: Holdout ROC-AUC chart: 'cross-validation mean' at 0.786 beside 0.801
findings.cause: mark labels drawn on the row's line
findings.fix: reference labels get their own row above the dots

findings.scenario: gains and precision-recall near the right edge
findings.cause: label at the reference line's end, where the curves meet
findings.fix: named at 62 % along a diagonal, at the left end of a flat line

findings.defect: 'no detector run' and a caught leak would show a red Leak badge
findings.scenario: machine kinds; declared columns that lift the score
findings.cause: every verdict but two mapped to bad
findings.test: page test verdict; R&D verdict tests

measurements.name: live, Sonnet 5.5, scripted test home
measurements.gate: plots through get_charts; a pick as a card
measurements.result: four turns, $0.61: charts called and explained; model choice as a card

outcome: Asking for a plot of a DCLab project draws its charts from the records, and a choice comes as a card to click.
lessons: Validate chart colours per mode: the dark accent that works for links failed beside a grey line.
Place a reference line's label where the model's curve is not.
risks: DCLab tools still ask Allow in the default mode (the owner's read-only question is open).
